BrochureContent.Content:
Superb 3-Bedroom Semi-Detached Home with Exceptional Rear Garden & Development Potential

Presented to the market by Liam Reilly Auctioneers, No. 544 Courtown Road is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a centrally located 3-bedroom semi-detached residence set on an exceptionally large site in the heart of Kilcock. Approximately 1 minute walk to the train station, which serves Dublin City Centre.

This attractive home is presented in very good condition throughout and offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation ideal for first-time buyers, families, downsizers, or investors alike. The property further benefits from extensive off-street parking to the front and a truly outstanding rear garden extending to an impressive length with enormous future potential, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Internally, the accommodation briefly comprises entrance porch, welcoming hallway, spacious living room, fitted kitchen, storeroom, three bedrooms, and a family bathroom.

The bright and cosy living room enjoys excellent natural light and features an attractive fireplace, creating a warm and comfortable family space. The kitchen is well-appointed with modern fitted units, ample worktop space, tiled splashback, and rear access to the garden.

Accommodation Includes:
•Entrance Porch
•Hallway
•Living Room 4.8m x 3.2m
•Kitchen 3.2m x 3.5m
•Store Room
•3 Bedrooms
•Family Bathroom

Outstanding Outdoor Space
A key feature of this superb property is the exceptionally long rear garden, which offers enormous scope for extension, further development, landscaping, or the creation of additional outdoor living areas, all subject to the appropriate planning permission.

The site is rare for such a central town location and provides excellent privacy together with endless potential for future enhancement. The large front driveway also provides ample off-street parking.

Features:
•Excellent town centre location
•Very good condition throughout
•Bright and spacious accommodation
•Extensive rear garden with huge potential
•Large site with development possibilities (subject to planning)
•Ample off-street parking
•Excellent investment opportunity
•Walking distance to all local amenities
•Ideal family home or starter property

Prime Location
No. 544 Courtown Road enjoys an enviable location within walking distance of all the amenities that Kilcock has to offer, including schools, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, gyms, sporting clubs, and excellent public transport services.

Kilcock continues to be one of North Kildare's most sought-after commuter towns due to its excellent transport links, including regular rail services to Dublin and immediate access to the M4 motorway. Nearby centres such as Maynooth, Leixlip, and Dublin are all easily accessible.

The area also benefits from scenic canal walks, recreational facilities, schools, and a vibrant local community atmosphere, making it an ideal place to call home.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a wonderful town centre property with substantial outdoor space and endless future potential in a highly convenient and desirable location.

Viewing comes highly recommended through the sole selling agents:
Liam Reilly Auctioneers
Early viewing is advised.

LIAM REILLY AUCTIONEERS give notice that all descriptions, dimensions, references to condition and necessary permissions for use and occupation, and other details are given in good faith and are believed to be correct, but any intending purchasers should not rely on them as statements or representations of fact but must satisfy themselves by inspection or otherwise as to the correctness of each of them.
